opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Research Project Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to any organisation, institution or nonprofit; collaborative applications welcomed. One grant per organisation per round.
opportunities.summary: Flexible financial support for organisations undertaking ambitious and sustained research in the field of British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Author Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to individuals at any career stage who have a confirmed publisher and a publication date within three years of applying.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for individuals to disseminate research on British art through monographs, edited collections, catalogues and articles.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Exhibition Publication Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to any organisation, institution or non‑profit; the exhibition may be forthcoming or already taken place.
opportunities.summary: Support for organisations to produce publications related to their exhibitions and displays, showcasing new research on British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Digitisation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to any organisation, institution or nonprofit undertaking digitisation of their own collections of British art material.
opportunities.summary: Financial support to make collections freely available online via digitisation, covering personnel and equipment costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Event Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to any organisation, institution or nonprofit; collaborative applications welcomed.
opportunities.summary: Support for organisations to disseminate research through live, online or hybrid events for a variety of audiences.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Conservation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to any organisation, institution or nonprofit undertaking conservation research on items in public or charitable ownership.
opportunities.summary: Funding to help protect and preserve significant works of British art by supporting original conservation research projects.
